    # 对每个 head，计算 action token 对 instruction tokens 的注意力占比
    attn_squeezed = l1_attn.squeeze(0)  # [heads, seq, seq]

    img_attn = action_attn[:, image_start:image_end].sum(dim=-1)  # [heads]
    total_attn = instr_attn + img_attn  # [heads]
    
    ratio = instr_attn / (total_attn + 1e-8)  # [heads] — instruction ratio per head
    
    if head_instruction_sum is None:
